summary: BBVA, S.A. filed a Rule 424(b)(5) prospectus supplement covering a $2.05 billion three-tranche offering of senior non-preferred notes: $750 million 5.609% fixed rate notes due 2029, $1 billion 6.213% fixed rate notes due 2036, and $300 million floating rate notes due 2029. Interest on fixed tranches pays semi-annually from May 2027; floating tranche pays quarterly. Notes are direct, unconditional, unsecured obligations ranking junior to senior preferred and privileged claims but senior to subordinated debt. This is ordinary bank capital funding, not a special situation; watch spread pricing and Tier 2 capital treatment.
